name: Atomoxetine
summary: Atomoxetine is a non-stimulant ADHD medicine that selectively inhibits norepinephrine reuptake.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP2D6 forms active 4-hydroxyatomoxetine, which is rapidly glucuronidated. CYP2C19 and other enzymes form the less active N-desmethyl metabolite. Elimination is predominantly urinary as metabolites.
